BDS - Enum constant in enum class org.geysermc.paletter.creative.CreativeOrdering
Exactly where Bedrock Dedicated Server (Windows build, verified on 1.26.63.1) puts add-on content, the default: Block items first, in the iteration order of BDS's map of data driven blocks (see CreativeOrdering.blockOrder(java.util.List<java.lang.String>, java.util.Collection<java.lang.String>)), then items in the order the layer defines them. With a group: at the end of the group of that name in the placement's category; a minecraft: prefix of the group name is ignored (minecraft:itemGroup.name.sword is the vanilla sword group).

forward(NbtMap) - Method in class org.geysermc.paletter.internal.CanonicalBlocks
Maps a state of any bundled version to the canonical ids, which the newest version defines: a state the newest version has (or a custom state of this lineage) is Forwarding.Kind.EXACT; a block Bedrock renamed is looked up under its new identifier (Forwarding.Kind.RENAMED); a block with other state keys or values is adapted like an older palette adapts newer states, the other way round: values the newest block still has are carried over, keys it added get the default, removed keys are dropped (Forwarding.Kind.ADAPTED); otherwise Forwarding.Kind.UNKNOWN with the reason, and no canonical id. Block fallbacks are not involved: they go from the newest version to an older one, this goes the other way.
forward(ItemVariant) - Method in class org.geysermc.paletter.internal.CanonicalItems

hash(NbtMap) - Static method in enum class org.geysermc.paletter.block.BlockNetworkIds
The hashed network id of a block state, as the client computes it: FNV-1a 32 bit over the little endian (not network / varint) NBT of the compound {name, states}, with an empty root name, the state values sorted by key, and no version tag.

Wire - Class in org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component
Value conversions the generated encoders use: add-on JSON values to the NBT type a wire leaf has.
WIRE - Enum constant in enum class org.geysermc.paletter.property.PropertyKind
Any other top level entry of the network data of an item or block (menu_category, molangVersion).
WireContext - Class in org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component
What one compilation of components targets: the palette's version (its protocol picks the mapping window), where to report what cannot be expressed, and the registry data transforms resolve descriptors against (whether an item exists, the types of a block's states).
WireContext.Registry - Interface in org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component
Item and block lookups for descriptors.
WireNode - Class in org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component
A mutable NBT compound the component encoders write into by dotted path (minecraft:durability.damage_chance.min).
WireNode() - Constructor for class org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component.WireNode
 
WireOnlyBlockComponent - Interface in org.geysermc.paletter.block.component
Hand-written block components for wire fields Bedrock clients read but add-on JSON cannot set (or no longer can): they have no source in the component model, so they are not generated.
WireOnlyItemComponent - Interface in org.geysermc.paletter.item.component
Hand-written item components for wire fields Bedrock clients read but add-on JSON cannot set (or no longer can): they have no source in the component model, so they are not generated.
WireOnlyWire - Class in org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component
Encoders of the hand-written WireOnlyItemComponents and WireOnlyBlockComponents, dispatched from the generated ItemWire.
